lens: senior product designer: visual hierarchy, typography, color in both themes, phone layout, presentation of messy data

J.notes: The most complete rethink: a sidebar app shell, a header summary that leads with what needs attention, grouped settings, and status color used with restraint in both themes. On phone the ledger tucks the project under the client name. It respects reduced motion (no animations run under reduce).
J.best: Content-led hierarchy (at-risk/overdue summary, '3 overdue, $10,361.25' in ledger header, project sub-line on phone)
issues: Task 'Add' button overflows its card by ~20px at 1280 (button right 759 vs card 738)
Ledger amounts still clip and need horizontal scroll at 390px

C.notes: The strongest handling of messy data: long names wrap, there's an Invoice column, the total reads 'net of 1 credit', the overdue figure is red, tabs show counts, and dates say 'Finished' or 'No due date'. Adds a skip link, 2px focus outlines, Clear filters and a 'Fill in the required fields' hint, with no regressions found.
C.best: Copy and data presentation that treats edge cases as first-class
issues: Wrapped client names create very tall ledger rows on phone
Top-nav search squeezes to 'Search p' at 390px
Reduced motion not honored (150ms animations remain)

D.notes: A careful baseline refinement. Task metadata moves under the title, so phone rows read well; long names wrap; there's a skip link; and the wizard's Next stays enabled but marks invalid fields and focuses the first one. Visual change is modest.
D.best: Task rows restructured (meta under title) so phone list stays readable
issues: Settings billing email 'billing@fieldwork' no longer flagged on load (validation deferred)

A.notes: Desktop polish is good: a numbered stepper, inline hints, an error icon, formatted numbers, a 'Total · all 14 entries' label, and full reduced-motion support. But the phone layout is broken: main content is 895px wide in a 390px viewport.
A.best: Wizard and validation microcopy with clear next-step hints
issues: Phone horizontal overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth 895 at 390px (MAIN grid)
Sortable header icons removed except on active column

K.notes: Small changes: a wizard progress bar with 'Step 1 of 3', monospace invoice IDs, and task titles that wrap. It reads as baseline otherwise.
issues: Stepper wraps awkwardly at 390px ('Step 1 of / 3', '3 Review' on its own line)

M.notes: Number formatting is consistent (9,512.00), and there's a 'Total for 14 entries' label and a continue hint in the wizard. Otherwise it's the baseline look.
M.best: Consistent two-decimal hour formatting in ledger
issues: Task titles truncate to a few characters on phone ('Send cat…', 'Review-d…')

G.notes: Barely different from baseline: slight spacing and type tweaks, with the same structure in both themes and on phone. No regressions seen.

B.notes: Visually identical to baseline; the r2/r3/overlay screenshots pixel-diff to 0%. No improvement and no regression.

F.notes: Effectively the baseline: under 0.5% of pixels differ, and those are spacing nudges. Nothing gained or lost.

H.notes: Effectively the baseline: under 0.5% of pixels differ. Nothing gained or lost.

E.notes: Strips card containers and input chrome down to bare text, so forms stop looking editable. Delete loses its destructive color, and the toggle labels are moved to the right. On phone the project cards are forced into 3 columns and the titles get crushed.
E.best: Snappy 80ms transitions and dot-style status badges
issues: Form inputs have 0px border and transparent background (wizard/settings fields look like plain text)
Phone: project grid stays 3-up at 390px, titles break per word
Delete button rendered neutral gray, not destructive
